comment: Combo definitions (user ruling 2026-11-05). Each combo is a 3-slot sequence of action codes a character can call: slot 1 must match the first code, slot 2 the second, slot 3 the third. Move-slot substitutions (M, EM, EP, P all count as 'M') apply when the slot code is 'M'. A wrong card at any slot resets the combo. Completing all 3 slots deals 1 damage to one adjacent enemy (Rule 15 picks) and resets the combo. Characters pick up a combo via characters.json entry-level `combo_id`; the resolver carries entity.comboState during a round.

entries.name: MAP
entries.desc: Move → Attack → Posture. Any Move-slot card (M/EM/EP/P) completes the opening step, then a straight Attack, then a Posture.

entries.name: APM
entries.desc: Attack → Posture → Move. Lead with the hit, hold the ground, then step away.

entries.name: BAM
entries.desc: Block → Attack → Move. Soak and counter, then slip out.
